snippet.title: Everyone Vs cillian Murphy | lol he's built different 🥶🗿 (Cillian Murphy Edit)
snippet.description:
cillian Murphy is built different 



Cillian Murphy is an Irish actor best known for his intense performances, piercing blue eyes, and versatile acting across film, television, and theatre. 🇮🇪🎬

Here's a quick overview:

Born: May 25, 1976 (Cork, Ireland)

Famous Roles:

Thomas Shelby in Peaky Blinders 🔫💼 (BBC crime drama series)

Oppenheimer in Oppenheimer (2023) – a role that won him widespread critical acclaim and an Oscar 🏆

Scarecrow (Dr. Jonathan Crane) in The Dark Knight trilogy (directed by Christopher Nolan)

Roles in other Nolan films like Inception, Dunkirk, and Oppenheimer


Style: Known for his quiet intensity, emotional depth, and often playing characters with dark or conflicted inner lives.

Fun Fact: He originally wanted to be a rock musician before fully committing to acting.
